name: Food Source / Radial Attractor
description: A radial food attractor with resource depletion. Produces territory formation: early arrivers deplete the source, triggering aggressive competition and resource partitioning.

preyResponse.description: Boids within attractionRadius are attracted; within competitionRadius they repel each other (resource competition). As the source depletes, the flock re-disperses and eventually reforms around a regenerated source or drifts to find a new one. This produces boom-bust aggregation cycles.

notes: Food aggregations differ from predator-driven responses: instead of panic, they produce radial inflow and internal competition. The balance between attraction weight and competition weight determines whether the aggregation forms a tight cluster (competition-dominated) or a diffuse inflow (attraction-dominated).
